product.description: Manages, pays, and reconciles vendor bills through a unified platform.

product.name: Accounts Receivable
product.description: Enables sending invoices, tracking, and accepting payments from customers.

product.name: Working Capital
product.description: Offers businesses the ability to pay suppliers up to 90 days later after selling products or services.

product.description: Provides real-time synchronization with QuickBooks and Xero to automate bookkeeping tasks.

product.description: Delivers real-time tracking and forecasting of business cash flow by consolidating financial data.
